**Finding submitted: INSURANCE — missing (fallback redline).**

- **Investigation:** The only "insurance" references in the document are commercial ones inside the Net Sales definition (freight/insurance costs at p0101; health insurance payers at p0102). Article 16 (Indemnification; Recalls) imposes mutual indemnities, including Products Liability Claims, but no insurance support; the General Provisions (18.1–18.14) contain no insurance covenant either.
- **Classification:** No usable insurance clause exists anywhere, so the rule is missing rather than a deviation from an existing bargain.
- **Cure:** A single `insert_after` at the end of the General Provisions adds Section 18.15 requiring Array to carry E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy of USD 2,000,000 — the fallback checklist, both elements mapped to that one operation. I deliberately did not volunteer the preferred CGL limits, workers' compensation, certificates, term tail or at-own-expense language, since those sit at the other level and are not required by the selected target.
